reasoning_content: The cms build is running slowly (memory is constrained, and the boards server is running with ~1.8GB of memory). Memory is flat at around 1.1GB — the build is slow but might still be progressing. Let's wait a bit longer for the build to complete (it's a cached build, but with memory constrained by the 2 active servers).

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 8); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39002/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "cms UP check $i"; break; }
  echo "check $i: cms=$code avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  sleep 45
done
tail -4 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/cms.log

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "for i in $(seq 1 8); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39002/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "cms UP check $i"; break; }
  echo "check $i: cms=$code avail=$(free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $6}')MB"
  sleep 45
done
tail -4 /workspace/.urbo/workspace/logs/cms.log", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Keep waiting for cms build"}
